text:
morgan: Heads-up from running the onboarding sample with accelerated token TTL: we saw a burst of duplicates and a 429 flood during a coordinated refresh.

zara: Saw something similar yesterday in staging. Can you paste the tiny timeline?

morgan: Sure, quick snippet from the sample app logs:
```
2026-07-10T09:10:00Z outgoing id=reqA auth=tok_old
2026-07-10T09:10:01Z got 401 -> triggering onAuthRefresh
2026-07-10T09:10:01Z onAuthRefresh done -> tok_new
2026-07-10T09:10:01Z SDK retried reqA immediately (no jitter) -> upstream 429
2026-07-10T09:10:01Z backoff counter reset -> retried again shortly -> duplicate side-effect
```

eli: This matches a parity issue: JS SDK resets backoff when onAuthRefresh resolves, while Py/Go preserve it. If many clients refresh in lockstep you get a retry storm.

zara: Short-term fixes: 1) preserve backoff attempt_count across auth refresh in all SDKs (parity), 2) add tiny randomized jitter to immediate post-refresh retry (example: 40-180ms), 3) update sample app quickstart to recommend Idempotency-Key for create-like endpoints.

morgan: I also suggest logging the backoff state (attempt_count/next_delay) in the sample harness to simplify postmortem.

eli: Agreed. Server-side dedupe (Idempotency-Key honoring) is strongest long-term, but SDK mitigations will reduce blast radius.

ops-bot: CI job queued: branch "sdk/preserve-backoff+post-refresh-jitter" will run integration tests at 2026-07-10T22:00Z.

zara: I'll open INFR ticket with repro script and attach the small harness and suggested patch list. Marking P2 unless we see customer impact.

morgan: Filed: https://redwood-internal/issues/INFR-9120 (includes logs, harness, and quick fix PR links). I'll add a tiny test that simulates 80 parallel clients doing refresh and assert duplicates <1%.

eli: I'll add a unit test to JS SDK asserting backoff state is unchanged after onAuthRefresh resolves and enable jitter flag default-on.

zara: After the staging run, let's run a 100-client overnight test and compare duplicate counts. If it still spikes, we'll consider introducing a short random delay on refresh start in the sample app as a last-resort mitigation.

morgan: Thanks, will monitor CI and report results here.
